method.stage_b: Per head, exact symmetric expected-Q was computed only at deduplicated prev/onset/next/epoch80/epoch140 checkpoints. Epoch140 samples were reused from the prior symmetric counterfactual report.
method.sv_head_identity: SV cache outputs were tracked by stable cache-head index. canonical_node_id is the seed-20001 label; physical SV node IDs vary across realizations.
method.left_censoring: An onset at epoch10 is left-censored because no earlier requested checkpoint exists; such a head cannot satisfy class C.
